name: TUFTE is the house's React: a framework that is not switched off and does not set the look
asks: Leader, 2026-09-29: TUFTE is meant to be our React-style framework, lol, a visual styling engine for websites. you can't just turn it off? that's like "turning off" css, from our perspective. / TUFTE sounds waaaaay too opinionated ... TUFTE is meant to be React. Another software, Apache. ... Tiles do not have to be fucking square boring shit ... all our web properties look identical and it's stupid. / 2026-08-27 to 2026-09-17: a family of apps that meets then beats modern website tooling; each web engine carries discrete capabilities and meets then beats the software in its class.

x-provenance.recorded-by: Lenticule Science Senior and Red Cup Engineer Senior (pass web-sites-public of debt-2026-10-09-leader-words-held-in-corpus)
x-provenance.basis: Leader utterances of 2026-08-27 to 2026-09-29, rendered in EARS; the requirements carry no scope the words do not.

board-opening.need: TUFTE serves every Group web property as the framework its interface is written in, and imposes no look of its own.

requirements.says: Every Group web property that has an interface shall render through the TUFTE engine.
requirements.rationale: The Leader: turning TUFTE off is like turning off CSS.

requirements.says: The TUFTE engine shall carry no look that a web property cannot replace.
requirements.rationale: The Leader: "TUFTE sounds waaaaay too opinionated".

requirements.says: The TUFTE engine shall place tiles of any shape that a property's composition names.
requirements.rationale: The Leader: "Tiles do not have to be ... square boring shit".

requirements.says: The TUFTE engine shall let two properties of the Group differ in composition and look.
requirements.rationale: The Leader: "all our web properties look identical and it's stupid".

requirements.says: The TUFTE engine shall meet and then beat the rendering frameworks of its class.
requirements.rationale: The Leader, 2026-09-17: "each does their best job to meet then beat the software in their respective classes".

requirements.says: A published page shall show the creation date of its cell.
requirements.rationale: The Leader read a page's creation date as wrong on 2026-09-29.

conditions.says: The note on TUFTE as the house's React exists beside the engine.
